questions.prompt: Trapezoid ABCD has AB ∥ DC. M and N are the midpoints of legs AD and BC. Prove that MN ∥ AB and MN = ½(AB + DC).

questions.required_method: Draw diagonal AC; let P be the midpoint of AC; use the midsegment theorem (or the converse) in △ACD and △ABC.
